description: Tracks whose file size is exactly 10,323,804 bytes are included along with larger ones.

d.request: For tracks with Bytes greater than or equal to 10,323,804 (inclusive cutoff), compute each media type's average of Bytes/Milliseconds, then list the media type names whose average is strictly greater than the simple (unweighted) mean of those per-media-type averages, showing the name, its average, and the average minus the overall mean, all unrounded.
d.sql: WITH per_media AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM per_media) SELECT p.Name, p.avg_ratio AS average_bytes_per_ms, p.avg_ratio - o.overall_mean AS diff_from_overall_mean FROM per_media p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_ratio > o.overall_mean

a.request: Considering only tracks whose file size (`Track.Bytes`) is at least 10,323,804 bytes, work out for each media type (by name) the average bytes per millisecond (`Bytes` ÷ `Milliseconds`) of its tracks. Which media types have an average strictly higher than the simple average of all these per-media-type averages? Show the media type name, its average, and how far it is above that overall average (its average minus the overall average). Leave all values unrounded.
a.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT mt.Name AS Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name) SELECT Name, avg_bpms, avg_bpms - (SELECT AVG(avg_bpms) FROM m) AS diff_from_overall FROM m WHERE avg_bpms > (SELECT AVG(avg_bpms) FROM m)

c.request: Considering only tracks that pass a file-size (`Track.Bytes`) cutoff of 10,323,804 bytes, work out for each media type (by name) the average bytes per millisecond (`Bytes` ÷ `Milliseconds`) of its tracks. Which media types have an average strictly higher than the simple average of all these per-media-type averages? Show the media type name, its average, and how far it is above that overall average (its average minus the overall average). Leave all values unrounded. Tracks whose file size is exactly 10,323,804 bytes are included along with larger ones.
c.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpm FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT MediaTypeName, avg_bpm, avg_bpm - (SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) FROM per) AS diff_from_overall FROM per WHERE avg_bpm > (SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) FROM per)
